{{Infobox number|number=80000}}
'''80,000''' ('''eighty thousand''') is the [[natural number]] after [[70,000#79000 to 79999|79,999]] and before 80,001.

==Selected numbers in the range 80,000–89,999==

* '''80,000''' = Since January 2024, the daily URL save limit for [[YouTube]] for the [[Wayback Machine]]
* '''80,782''' = [[Pell number]] ''P''<sub>14</sub><ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A000129|2=Pell numbers|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''81,081''' = smallest [[abundant number]] ending in 1, 3, 7, or 9
* '''81,181''' = number of reduced trees with 25 nodes<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000014|Number of series-reduced trees with n nodes}}</ref>
* '''82,000''' = the only currently known number greater than 1 that can be written in bases from 2 through 5 using only 0s and 1s.<ref>Sequence [http://oeis.org/A146025 A146025] in The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences</ref><ref>Sequence [http://oeis.org/A258107 A258107] in The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences</ref>
* '''82,025''' = number of primes <math>\leq 2^{20}</math>.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A007053|Number of primes <= 2^n|access-date=2022-06-02}}</ref>
* '''82,467''' = number of square (0,1)-matrices without zero rows and with exactly 6 entries equal to 1<ref>{{cite OEIS|A122400|Number of square (0,1)-matrices without zero rows and with exactly n entries equal to 1}}</ref>
* '''82,656''' = [[Kaprekar number]]: 82656<sup>2</sup> = 6832014336; 68320 + 14336 = 82656<ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A006886|2=Kaprekar numbers|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''82,944''' = 3-[[smooth number]]: 2<sup>10</sup> × 3<sup>4</sup>
* '''83,097''' = [[oeis:A005043|Riordan number]]
* '''83,160''' = the 29th [[highly composite number]]<ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A002182|2=Highly composite numbers|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''83,357''' = [[Friedman prime]]<ref>{{OEIS|id=A112419}}</ref>
* '''84,672''' = number of primitive polynomials of degree 21 over GF(2)<ref>{{cite OEIS|A011260|Number of primitive polynomials of degree n over GF(2)}}</ref>
* '''85,085''' = product of five consecutive primes: 5 × 7 × 11 × 13 × 17
* '''87,360''' = [[unitary perfect number]]<ref>{{Cite OEIS|1=A002827|2=Unitary perfect numbers|access-date=2016-06-16}}</ref>
* '''88,789''' = the start of a [[prime k-tuple|prime 9-tuple]], along with 88793, 88799, 88801, 88807, 88811, 88813, 88817, and 88819.
* '''89,134''' = number of partitions of 45<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000041|a(n) is the number of partitions of n (the partition numbers)}}</ref>

===Primes===
There are 876 prime numbers between 80000 and 90000.
